title: Create the conforming Phase 2 Generation 2 documentation correction
objective: Correct the exact Phase 2 documentation and validator defects identified by DEAS while preserving immutable Generation 1 observations, uncertainties, privacy boundaries, and the absence of a Role Disposition.

scope.description: The exact 15-path C4 package correction; Git delivery is external.

non_goals: Recollect, reinterpret, normalize, or replace any original observation
Resolve an UNKNOWN or BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE value
Assign a Role Disposition, qualify or release the system, or begin Phase 3
Adopt DEAS outside the DobeWorks repository
Complete, predict, or attest the commit, pushed ref, pull-request head, or other Git delivery identity inside this immutable package
Access or change devices, storage, credentials, permissions, private sources, repository settings, collaborators, or unrelated files
Amend, rebase, reset, force-push, delete, or rewrite history
requirements: Preserve Generation 1 at commit f45ae80c64a0aa8c723a5a58b4fbc7073682d349 and reproduce its exact six DEAS findings.
Change exactly the 15 C4 paths frozen by the accepted DEAS plan.
Replace stale Phase 2 reservations and unchecked historical entry items only where exact evidence supplies a truthful disposition.
Implement all 23 canonical evidence-record fields for the four consequential records without moving or changing an original line.

Keep each Python function within 60 logical code lines and fail closed on missing, malformed, oversize, out-of-root, manifest-mismatched, changed-original, timeout, execution-error, or noisy subprocess input.
Require exact package and Generation 2 manifests, silent structured Phase 2 and DEGS results, and independent DEAS corroboration.
Require the corrected DEAS definition at commit ca8efcefe6568a7a64b5b6d930031dff0131efec with manifest-file SHA-256 3f40080f3cd725db8906385abb6f7db79fadef5a231cf6bc9206b2fa43863c88.
Keep JSON-mode argument and runtime failures inside one closed-schema public error seam with stable rule IDs and paths.
Keep Role Disposition at not assigned and preserve every unknown, blocked state, privacy boundary, and excluded action.
acceptance_criteria: The public Phase 2 CLI returns the exact schema-v2 PASS object with empty standard error.
The public DEAS Generation 2 CLI returns package-scoped PASS with zero semantic findings, independent compound corroboration, and G7/G8/G9 explicitly pending.
Generation 1 still exits 1 with exactly the frozen six ordered findings.
The canonical DEGS validate and evaluate commands return exact silent PASS JSON.
Syntax, function size, JSON, links, manifests, diff, secret, positive, negative, timeout, execution-error, and original-line preservation checks pass.
Standards and Spec review have no blocking finding.

The immutable package remains READY_FOR_EXECUTION, changes exactly the 15 C4 paths, and hands off in READY_FOR_GIT_DELIVERY state; review, commit, push, pull-request, unchanged-main, unmerged, and exact-result acceptance identities remain external evidence.
assumptions: The delivered definition-correction predecessor is ca8efcefe6568a7a64b5b6d930031dff0131efec and remains the branch and draft pull-request head before resumed C4.
C2 and immutable Generation 1 are f45ae80c64a0aa8c723a5a58b4fbc7073682d349.
The corrected DEAS v1.0 definition has tree e785cafa49bdfcc3ec5e660d3a87c943047d9ef5 and manifest-file SHA-256 3f40080f3cd725db8906385abb6f7db79fadef5a231cf6bc9206b2fa43863c88.
alternatives: Treat the three semantic finding families as waived
Rely on a nested Phase 2 PASS assertion without independent DEAS corroboration
selected_design: Create one immutable successor generation with additive evidence-contract metadata, exact historical dispositions, public-seam fail-closed validation, non-circular manifests, and no change to original observations or authority.

rollback.procedure: Preserve the exact definition-correction predecessor, verified resumed-C4 Git bundle, Generation 1 snapshot, C4 candidate, manifests, validation evidence, and owned lock on failure. Do not amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or automatically roll back.

risk_analysis.summary: Tier 1 reversible private-repository documentation and validator work, bounded by exact paths, immutable predecessors, deterministic tests, a verified backup, an existing private branch, and a draft pull request.

target_identity: Definition-correction commit ca8efcefe6568a7a64b5b6d930031dff0131efec plus exactly the 15 C4 paths and the externally bound generation-2-sha256.txt.
blast_radius: Exactly 15 C4 package paths; no Git delivery identity, main, merge, release, device, storage, credential, or cross-workspace change is completed by this package task.
stop_conditions: A predecessor, branch, path, original line, manifest, private-remote, task-lock, or writer check changes unexpectedly.
Any required check fails and cannot be corrected within the exact C4 authority.
Any exception, unsupported fact, path expansion, authentication interaction, non-fast-forward push, or review finding requiring scope expansion becomes necessary.

Any merge, root adoption, Phase 3, qualification, release, Role Disposition, evidence recollection, device, storage, credential, permission, physical, destructive, security-setting, collaborator, or unrelated action would occur.
